decided: The instruction every workflow skill with a disciplines epitome carries now asks for a ledger entry after any call in the ledger's areas, however the AI reached it, including after a clarifying question no stop condition describes.
alternatives: keep recording only calls made without asking or with the user's answer to a stop
why: The decision records are meant to keep every call the AI made in those areas; a call reached after a clarifying question is still such a call, and leaving it out would leave gaps in the record the first run is graded from.

relies_on.title: Three decision records, one job each
